label: Distinct esse has an external cause, from its external efficient cause (inference)
meaning: Strength order (backing result): the efficient reading of the q.3 a.4 conclusion entails its mode-unspecified reading, STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE, by dropping the conjunct that the cause is efficient. The converse fails (NonEfficientCauseControl). This argument passes from CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_6 to CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_2 and declares its conclusion as that bridge. It adds no support to STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE beyond what the De ente step 457698e4 already gives: the two are the same proposition on the same profile (otherActualCauseIffExternalCause), so a route into it through the efficient reading only adds the efficiency bridge, which this step discards.
